dedupe_keys.name: supplementary dataset for ahp based material selection of water supply pipes

description: Mutlag Sattar, Abed Kadhum and Yousif Al Mashhadany publish an Excel workbook supporting analytic-hierarchy-process selection of water-supply pipe materials. The February 2026 Zenodo deposit contains pairwise comparison matrices, normalised eigenvectors, global weight calculations and sensitivity-analysis data. It is freely available under CC BY 4.0. These decision inputs can help reproduce the weighting procedure or test how pipe-material choices change when planning assumptions change. The public metadata leave the candidate materials, criterion definitions, elicitation sample, geographical case and assessment dates unknown. The matrices represent a study's judgements and should not be treated as measured failure rates or universal material rankings. A modeller would need to inspect the workbook before transferring weights into an intervention-planning simulation. No related catalogue record explicitly identifies this workbook. Only its metadata and file name were inspected, and no numerical consistency checks were performed.
